title: A map of the simplex category missing i factors uniquely through the face map omitting i
statement: Let $\Delta$ be the category of the ordered sets $[m]=\{0<1<\dots<m\}$ and order-preserving maps [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-set], and for $n\geq1$ and $0\leq i\leq n$ let $\delta^n_i:[n-1]\to[n]$ be the increasing injection omitting $i$, i.e. $\delta^n_i(x)=x$ for $x<i$ and $\delta^n_i(x)=x+1$ for $x\geq i$. Let $k\geq0$, $n\geq1$, let $\alpha:[k]\to[n]$ be order-preserving and let $0\leq i\leq n$ with $i\notin\alpha([k])$. Then there is a unique order-preserving map $\psi:[k]\to[n-1]$ with $\alpha=\delta^n_i\circ\psi$; if $\alpha$ is injective, then so is $\psi$.
